verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents social sign-in as a built-in AuthKit method. It advertises sign-in "with Microsoft, Google, and more", and pricing says social login comes "all from one integration" through a customizable hosted UI. That supports offering social login without bespoke per-provider code. However, the evidence names only two providers and never shows dashboard-level provider configuration. One community report of a Slack OAuth option the user could not find is too vague to count as a contradiction. missing for 10: a documented list showing a broad provider catalog, explicit docs on enabling or configuring social providers in the dashboard, generic OAuth/OIDC social provider support, independent hands-on corroboration.
